title: The River-Oath of Evermor
summary: Defend the Bjoulsae river-trade and the horse-clans of Evermor against a coalition of briar-heart Reach raiders and corrupt toll-wardens who have seized the river-locks.

npcs.name: River-Marshal Gervais
npcs.greet: Rein in your mount, traveller! The Bjoulsae boom-chain at Evermor is raised, and no timber barge has come down from Bhoriane in four days.
talk: Winterborn Reachfolk have come down from the eastern crags in force, yet someone opened the river-towers for them without a single arrow loosed.
Our horse-breeder scouts at The Crooked Tortoise caught a toll-clerk carrying Dwemer lock-bars toward Tzinzak. Ride there and speak with Outrider Solange.

npcs.name: Outrider Solange
npcs.greet: By the Horse-Father's stirrup, I'm glad to see steel from Evermor! My mare lamed a shoe outrunning the briar-hearts on the towpath.
talk: Viscount Dancourt of Castle Leclair is paying Reach Warlord Madanach-Kin to raid rival barges so his own toll-wharves monopolize the river!
Dancourt's engineers are inside the Dwemer waterworks of Tzinzak right now, dropping the river level so the barges ground on the shoals.

npcs.name: Barge-Master Henri
npcs.greet: Sixteen wool-barges stranded in the mud at Bhoriane, and the Reachmen shooting fire-arrows from the bluffs every dusk!
talk: Once you reopen the Dwemer sluices in Tzinzak, take the river-road to Castle Jourdain and Pengate Keep—that's where Red-Crow Morcant has penned his warband.

npcs.name: Captain Amaury of the River-Horse
npcs.greet: Look sharp! Red-Crow Morcant and Viscount Dancourt's turncoats have retreated into Blackthornhaven Burrow above the gorge.
talk: If we break Morcant's briar-heart circle in Blackthornhaven Burrow, the eastern passes and the Bjoulsae towpath will be free for another generation.

story_bj_tortoise_towpath: Outrider Solange: Look at the Bjoulsae water-mark on the pier—dropped four feet overnight because someone turned the Dwemer flood-wheels in Tzinzak!
River-Marshal Gervais: And see the crow-feathers tied to the milestone? A Reach boundary-totem, planted beside a Breton toll-post.
Outrider Solange: Strike Tzinzak first before every barge at Bhoriane is burned on the mudflats!
story_bj_tzinzak_sluice: Sluice-Warden Valentin: Viscount Dancourt paid good gold for a dry riverbed! Stand away from the bronze valve-wheel!
Outrider Solange: The Bjoulsae belongs to the barge-men and the horse-clans, traitor! Turn the wheel!
story_bj_blackthorn_circle: Red-Crow Morcant: Your river-nobles sold us the lock-keys for a handful of toll-silver, and now the whole valley is our hunting-ground!
Captain Amaury of the River-Horse: No Reach totem stands while the Horsemen of Evermor keep their oath! Charge!

quests.title: Low Water on the Bjoulsae
quests.summary: Ride from Evermor to The Crooked Tortoise and inspect the drained towpath with Outrider Solange.
intro: The Bjoulsae River has mysteriously dropped four feet overnight, stranding wool and timber barges beneath Reachmen ambush points.
Speak with River-Marshal Gervais in Evermor and ride to The Crooked Tortoise to meet Outrider Solange.
complete: Outrider Solange discovered that Sluice-Warden Valentin is diverting the river inside the Dwemer waterworks of Tzinzak.

journal.start: River-Marshal Gervais in Evermor asked me to meet Outrider Solange at The Crooked Tortoise along the Bjoulsae towpath.
journal.done: We traced the river diversion to the Dwemer waterworks at Tzinzak.

quests.title: The Bronze Flood-Wheels of Tzinzak
quests.summary: Enter the Dwemer waterworks of Tzinzak, defeat Sluice-Warden Valentin, and reopen the river sluices.
intro: Sluice-Warden Valentin has locked the ancient Dwemer flood-wheels in Tzinzak on Viscount Dancourt's orders.
Enter Tzinzak, defeat Valentin, and release the water back into the Bjoulsae channel.
complete: With Valentin defeated and the bronze flood-wheels turned, the Bjoulsae surged back into its channel toward Bhoriane.

journal.start: I must enter Tzinzak, defeat Sluice-Warden Valentin, and reopen the river sluices.
journal.done: I defeated Sluice-Warden Valentin and restored the water level of the Bjoulsae River.

quests.title: Horsemen of the Towpath
quests.summary: Check on the refloated barges with Barge-Master Henri in Bhoriane and ride to Captain Amaury at Pengate Keep.
intro: Now that the river has risen, check with Barge-Master Henri in Bhoriane to learn where the Reach raiders retreated.
Speak with Barge-Master Henri in Bhoriane, then join Captain Amaury at Pengate Keep.
complete: Captain Amaury at Pengate Keep has cornered Red-Crow Morcant's warband inside Blackthornhaven Burrow.

journal.start: I must speak with Barge-Master Henri in Bhoriane and ride to Captain Amaury at Pengate Keep.
journal.done: Captain Amaury pinpointed Red-Crow Morcant's main camp inside Blackthornhaven Burrow.

quests.title: The Briar-Heart of Blackthornhaven
quests.summary: Storm Blackthornhaven Burrow, slay Red-Crow Morcant, and return the toll-charters to River-Marshal Gervais in Evermor.
intro: Red-Crow Morcant has gathered his briar-heart warriors in Blackthornhaven Burrow with Viscount Dancourt's treasonous letters.
Enter Blackthornhaven Burrow, defeat Red-Crow Morcant, and bring the letters back to River-Marshal Gervais in Evermor.
complete: Red-Crow Morcant is dead, Viscount Dancourt has been stripped of his river-tolls, and the barges of the Bjoulsae sail freely to the bay.

journal.start: I must enter Blackthornhaven Burrow, defeat Red-Crow Morcant, and return to River-Marshal Gervais in Evermor.
journal.done: I slew Red-Crow Morcant in Blackthornhaven Burrow and restored the River-Oath of Evermor.
